riskEntries.title: Adaptive Orchestrator Turbulence Scheme Hardcoding
riskEntries.engineeringImpact: Engine silently ignores case-specified SST k-omega or laminar request, running k-epsilon instead, leading to unphysical separation predictions.
riskEntries.mitigationStrategy: Update AdaptiveIndustrialCFDEngine lines 129-131 to inspect caseDef.turbulenceModelIdentity and caseDef.flowRegime, routing K_EPSILON, SST_K_OMEGA, or LAMINAR accordingly.

riskEntries.title: GCI Engine Hardcoded to Aerodynamic CL Metric
riskEntries.engineeringImpact: Internal duct and channel flows evaluate CL nominally near 0.0, causing apparent order or asymptotic range arithmetic degradation.
riskEntries.mitigationStrategy: Generalize GCI calculation to support arbitrary scalar quantities (e.g. pressureDropPa, dragCoefficientCd, massImbalancePercent) with safe zero-value normalization.

riskEntries.title: Global Momentum Balance Telemetry Decoupling
riskEntries.engineeringImpact: Evidence artifact seals mass conservation but lacks automated momentum flux imbalance certificate.
riskEntries.mitigationStrategy: Compute and bind global momentum imbalance norm into evidence telemetry alongside mass balance.

riskEntries.title: Advanced Dynamic Boundary Conditions Omission
riskEntries.engineeringImpact: Users cannot model total pressure inlets or convective supersonic boundaries.
riskEntries.mitigationStrategy: Explicitly define and bound declared qualification scope to INLET (velocity), OUTLET (pressure), WALL, and SYMMETRY.

riskEntries.title: Analytical Benchmark End-to-End Test Disconnection
riskEntries.engineeringImpact: Benchmark validation relies on manual inspection rather than continuous gate testing.
riskEntries.mitigationStrategy: Create an automated acceptance harness that runs analytical Poiseuille channel flow and compares exact parabolic velocity profile.

riskEntries.title: Compressible Solver Quarantined Prototype
